  intros H; cases H <;> simp

  intros Hdef Heval

  | update Hold HH Hsome =>

  intros v' Hv'
  by_cases Heq: (v = v')
  case pos =>

  case neg =>
    specialize Hsome v' Heq

    exact Hdef Hv'

  intros v' Hv'

  case neg =>

    specialize Hdef v'
    simp [← Hsome]

  intros Hdef Heval

/-- ### Predicates on `SemanticStore`s -/

@[expose] def isDefined {P : PureExpr} (σ : SemanticStore P) (vs : List P.Ident) : Prop :=
  ∀ v, v ∈ vs → (σ v).isSome = true

def isNotDefined {P : PureExpr} (σ : SemanticStore P) (vs : List P.Ident) : Prop :=
  ∀ v, v ∈ vs → σ v = none

/-- Every `Q`-kind slot is undefined in `σ`.  Predicate-keyed generalisation of
`isNotDefined`: `isNotDefined σ vs` is the `(· ∈ vs)` specialisation of this. -/
@[expose] def SemanticStore.varsUndefined {P : PureExpr}
    (Q : P.Ident → Prop) (σ : SemanticStore P) : Prop :=
  ∀ y, Q y → σ y = none

  ∃ σ₁,

  unfold updatedStates

    exact fun x Hx Hy => Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mp (Hdef x Hy) (Hnd x Hx))]
  exact updatedStatesUpdate Hl2 $ updatedStatesDefMonotone Hdef
